title: Issue with Keyboard Manager shortcuts after v0.96.1 update

judgment.rationale: The reporter says the Alt+; and Alt+' shortcuts that type middle dot and degree stop working after 0.96.1, while other shortcuts work. The issue does not state the keyboard layout or whether the failure persists on a current build; a comment links #43302 and #43845 without explaining whether either resolves this exact mapping.
evidence: The issue names the exact source chords Alt+; and Alt+' and intended characters · and °.
The reporter says the PowerToys process remains running and other shortcuts work.
The sole comment references #43302 and #43845; no assignee or linked PR is present.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask whether the two shortcuts still fail on a current build and confirm their exact mapping type and keyboard layout.

fix_assessment.rationale: The report is tied to 0.96.1 and omits layout and destination configuration; current status must be confirmed before selecting a cause.

issue_context.summary: After upgrading to PowerToys 0.96.1, two shortcuts intended to emit · and ° reportedly stop working, although the process and other shortcuts remain active.
known_information: The reported source chords are Alt+semicolon and Alt+apostrophe.
The expected output is middle dot and degree; other shortcuts reportedly continue to work.
The only comment links #43302 and #43845; the report has no current-build confirmation.
inferences: The issue may depend on source key interpretation, keyboard layout, or the Send Text target configuration rather than a full module failure.
issue_context.analysis: The targeted missing facts are current-version persistence, layout, and the exact target action for each chord. Avoid a generic /bugreport request before those facts narrow the failing path.
initial_investigation: Read the complete live body and sole comment.
Checked labels, assignees, and linked references; no direct fix or assignment is present.

information_gaps.information: Whether the failure persists on a current build, the active keyboard layout, and whether each shortcut targets Send Text or another action.
information_gaps.why_needed: This distinguishes a changed shortcut/source-key interpretation from a text-target configuration issue.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Confirm current PowerToys version and layout; for Alt+; and Alt+', state the configured target action and whether each fails independently while a known-good shortcut still works.

comment.body:
Thanks for specifying that Alt+; and Alt+' are intended to type · and °, and that other shortcuts still work. The report is on 0.96.1, so it is not yet clear whether this persists on a current version or depends on the active keyboard layout/target type.

Please confirm your current PowerToys version and keyboard layout, and say whether each mapping targets Send Text or another action. Also confirm whether the two shortcuts fail independently while another known-good mapping continues to work. This will distinguish source-key interpretation from target configuration.
